intent: Promote the fully validated canonical-only Home Environment Manager after beta26 was published before the final canonical storage-key cleanup. Preserve beta26 room profile targets and active controller method behavior, with every runtime/store namespace canonicalized to environment_manager.
note: Supersede beta26 with canonical storage keys plus validated room targets and active PID/Automatic controller operation
changes: Supersede beta26 because two native controller safety stores still used historical air_quality_advisor storage keys
Use environment_manager exclusively for manifest/config flow/services/runtime and every persisted storage key; no old-domain migration code ships
Expose Comfort, Home, Away, Sleep and Eco Room Environment targets with capability-gated heating, cooling and humidity values
Keep Away as an explicit editable profile rather than replacing it with hard room min/max limits
Selecting Automatic, PID or Manual authorizes the exact native controller to start/stop its supported physical device/native HVAC mode on verified demand; no second power switch exists
Reselecting an active method re-arms a software pause and minimum-OFF uses the physical entity's actual observed OFF age
Retain minimum ON/OFF, max runtime, window, availability, ownership, defrost/interlock and acknowledgement protections
